cohort: 40 critically ill pregnant, labouring, postpartum, and post-abortal women admitted to the intensive care unit at GGH Anantapur, identified from 4265 deliveries over a 6-month period.
finding: The major causes of maternal near miss were antepartum eclampsia, anaemia, respiratory failure, and haemorrhage.
followup_time: within 42 days of pregnancy termination (based on WHO MNM definition)
